# Source Index

Use this file only in the evidence profile. It routes exact source IDs to authoritative locations; it is not a replacement for the original source.

| ID | Location | Version / date | Supports | Limits | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Source Rules

- Allocate globally stable `SRC-*` IDs.
- Record exact paths, URLs, pages, headings, versions, or hashes where practical.
- State what a source does not establish.
- Historical AI drafts are not authoritative sources unless the user explicitly promotes them.
